title: Ukrainian forces cross into Russia's Kursk region
body:
On 6 August 2024 Ukrainian forces crossed the border from Sumy Oblast into Russia's Kursk region near the town of Sudzha. Meduza reported that the attack involved several battalions of Ukraine's 22nd Mechanized Brigade, reinforced with special forces and air defence systems, and possibly battalions from other regular brigades. Russian defenders were mainly border guards and infantry from a border cover regiment formed the previous year, partly made up of non-mobilised conscripts, and local defences had almost no armoured vehicles.

Ukrainian forces captured the Sudzha border checkpoint after a day of fighting and the Sudzha gas metering station a few hundred yards from it, which is part of the infrastructure through which Russian gas still flowed to Europe via Ukraine. They reached the highway near Sverdlikovo linking Rylsk and Sudzha and occupied the villages of Leonidovo and Zelenyi Shliakh. Russian bloggers claimed that forward units reached the outskirts of Korenevo, which Meduza could not confirm.

Russia's initial response was airstrikes by jets, helicopters and Iskander missiles, which hit several Ukrainian armoured vehicles but did not stop the advance. At least one Russian helicopter was shot down. As of the evening of 7 August, large Russian reserves had not yet entered the fighting.
